messages:
nora (Partner Eng): Partner CI found regressions with driver 24.1 + CUDA12.2 on quantized models — p95 up ~20%, occasional kernel OOMs.
aj (HW Partner): We see failing matmul sanity tests. Error: `cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources` in matmul_kernel_v2.
kevin (Runtime Eng): Repro'd locally. Forcing selector to matmul_v1 removes the regressions. I'll add a runtime toggle.
sofia (Marketplace): Current AMIs pinned at driver 23.7. We should do a canary image pinned to 23.7.2 while fix lands.
olivia (PM): Need timeline and partner comms. Can we get hotfix + canary in 48h?
nora (Partner Eng): Plan: 1) runtime hotfix behind toggle (24.1.1) 2) build `edge-driver-23-7` image pinned to driver=23.7.2 + cuda=12.1.x 3) run partner CI matrix + 5% canary bake 4) promote if green. Aim: hotfix+canary in 48h.
aj (HW Partner): Partner will run extended matrix tonight and upload logs to s3://partner-regressions/2301111111.
kevin (Runtime Eng): Opening PR runtime#1050 with flags `rc.force_legacy_matmul` and `rc.selector_canary`. CI will include perf baseline checks. ETA 6-8h.
sofia (Marketplace): Marketplace ops can tag `marketplace/redwood-inference:edge-23-7-<sha>` and schedule a limited EU bake after CI. Need partner/legal sign-off for managed fleets.
deploy-bot: Scheduled bake for `marketplace/redwood-inference:edge-23-7` at 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z. Will notify #eng-releases on completion.
olivia (PM): Drafted rollback playbook and set cross-org sync 16:00 PT.
nora (Partner Eng): Rollback playbook snippet:
``n1) route traffic to driver=23.7 pool
2) set `rc.force_legacy_matmul=true`
3) run smoke perf tests (p50/p95)
4) monitor for 1h, escalate if >5% failures
5) notify customers if rollback >4h
```
kevin (Runtime Eng): Adding smoke tests and perf thresholds to CI.
aj (HW Partner): Will share matrix results by 22:00 PT.
sofia (Marketplace): I'll prepare packaging notes and a short migration readme for self-managed customers.
nora (Partner Eng): Thanks — if anything blocks the 48h plan post here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
